# Ophthalmology — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is the role of Ophthalmology?", "cataracts, LASIK"),
    ("What category is Ophthalmology?", "eyes"),
    ("What is category?", "eyes"),

    ("What is note?", "Surgical + medical"),
]

    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")

        print(f"Answer: {a}")
